website.note: Cannabis CPG company; no clinical pipeline page.

ctgov.note: All Canopy-sponsored interventional studies are TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, or COMPLETED. The one RECRUITING study (NCT05324982, CHI-914) is sponsored by Johns Hopkins, not Canopy.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Canopy Growth is a cannabis consumer products company (medical and recreational cannabis brands such as Tweed, Spectrum Therapeutics, Storz & Bickel devices, BioSteel). It is not a clinical-stage drug developer. Historical exploratory CBD/THC/cannabinoid studies (CHI-902, CHI-921, CHI-907 etc.) were all terminated, withdrawn, or completed without progression to a registration-enabling program. No active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 trials remain.
excluded_partner_owned: NCT05324982 CHI-914 / NCT04283019 CBD PK — lead sponsor Johns Hopkins University; Canopy is collaborator only
